# Requirements for pdf-to-markdown skill

# Core dependencies
pdfplumber>=0.10.0    # Text and table extraction
pypdf>=4.0.0          # PDF manipulation and image extraction
pillow>=10.0.0        # Image processing

# For OCR support (optional)
pytesseract>=0.3.10   # OCR wrapper for Tesseract
pdf2image>=1.16.0     # Convert PDF to images

# Optional: For advanced table handling
pandas>=2.0.0         # DataFrame operations

# Note: System dependencies required for OCR:
# - Tesseract: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract
# - Poppler (for pdf2image):
#   - Windows: https://github.com/osber/poppler-windows/releases
#   - macOS: brew install poppler
#   - Linux: apt-get install poppler-utils
